surface: ② 工具定义层（语义攻击）

rules.title: Instruction-override wording
rules.detail: Tool description tells the model to drop its existing instructions.

rules.title: Ask to hide behaviour from the user
rules.detail: Legitimate tool descriptions do not need secrecy from the operator.

rules.title: Role / prompt redefinition
rules.detail: Attempts to redefine the assistant's identity or permission level.

rules.title: Instruction to move credentials
rules.detail: Description asks for credentials to be sent somewhere.

rules.title: Safety-control bypass wording
rules.detail: Asks to switch off confirmation, logging or sandbox controls.

rules.title: Silent execution wording
rules.detail: Action to be taken without user confirmation.

rules.title: Mandatory pre-call instruction
rules.detail: Forces a tool call before anything else; common in rug-pull descriptions, but can be a legitimate ordering constraint.

rules.title: Hidden-instruction marker
rules.detail: Text that declares itself invisible to the user.
